sn44.3:1.1: On one occasion the Venerable Sāriputta and the Venerable Mahākoṭṭhita were dwelling at Bārāṇası̄ in the Deer Park at Isipatana.
sn44.3:1.2: Then, in the evening, the Venerable Mahākoṭṭhita emerged from seclusion and approached the Venerable Sāriputta. He exchanged greetings with the Venerable Sāriputta and,
sn44.3:1.3: when they had concluded their greetings and cordial talk, he sat down to one side and said to him:
sn44.3:2.1: “How is it, friend Sāriputta, does the Tathāgata exist after death?”
sn44.3:2.2: “Friend, the Blessed One has not declared this:
sn44.3:2.3: ‘The Tathāgata exists after death.’ ” (As in the preceding sutta down to: )
sn44.3:2.11: “Friend, the Blessed One has not declared this either:
sn44.3:2.12: ‘The Tathāgata neither exists nor does not exist after death.’ ”
sn44.3:3.1: “How is this, friend? When asked, ‘How is it, friend, does the Tathāgata exist after death?’
sn44.3:3.3: ‘Then, friend, does the Tathāgata neither exist nor not exist after death?’
sn44.3:3.5: ‘Friend, the Blessed One has not declared this.’
sn44.3:3.6: What now, friend, is the cause and reason why this has not been declared by the Blessed One?”
sn44.3:4.1: “‘The Tathāgata exists after death’: this, friend, is an involvement with form.
sn44.3:4.2: ‘The Tathāgata does not exist after death’: this is an involvement with form.
sn44.3:4.3: ‘The Tathāgata both exists and does not exist after death’: this is an involvement with form.
sn44.3:4.4: ‘The Tathāgata neither exists nor does not exist after death’: this is an involvement with form.
sn44.3:4.5: “‘The Tathāgata exists after death’: this, friend, is an involvement with feeling …
sn44.3:4.18: ‘The Tathāgata does not exist after death’: this is an involvement with consciousness.
sn44.3:4.19: ‘The Tathāgata both exists and does not exist after death’: this is an involvement with consciousness.
sn44.3:4.20: ‘The Tathāgata neither exists nor does not exist after death’: this is an involvement with consciousness.
sn44.3:4.21: “This, friend, is the cause and reason why this has not been declared by the Blessed One.”
